create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 fast signed-inverse transport reduction
create.statement_tex: Fix X>=2, a nonempty literal middle or lower residual hard-M1 shell L>=2, sigma in {+1,-1}, fixed B>0, Q=H_B=floor((log(2X))^B), and a nonempty dyadic Y<h<=2Y. On the exact Round-189 fast packet U=mq>4Q, q>Q, m|a|_q>Q, Qm<Y, j_q(a,v)>T_Q=min((q-1)/2,floor(Qmq/Y)), retain U|u, g=u/U, kappa,g,U odd, every literal field, and one outer real part over both orientations. Let rho_U(v) be the signed least inverse modulo U, rho_U(v)v-gamma_U(v)U=1, and put T_rho=min((U-1)/2,floor(QmU/Y)). The complete row sector 0<|rho_U(v)|<=T_rho, the live-side outer height/carrier-terminal projection on its complement, and the isolated Fejer-difference projection on persistent outer masks and transported common sites have fixed-packet size O_epsilon(Qm kappa u X^epsilon). After the exact c_(mq)(ma)=m^(-1)c_q(a) lift, coefficient mass, power-of-two projective bands, tau_3(u) divisor ledger, u asymp L/kappa, and L<<X^(1/4), their full contribution is O_(B,epsilon)(L^2X^epsilon). The inverse-sector proof is cardinality only: inversion permutes unit classes modulo U, so #v<<uT_rho/U<<Qmu/Y. Adjacent determinant fibres transport exactly by (S,w)->(S-epsilon_omega rho_U(v),w-epsilon_omega gamma_U(v)); canonical reindexing has carry nu_omega(h) in {-1,0,1}, and a retained mode has factor (-1)^nu e(epsilon_omega a rho_U(v)/q), not the full pre-Fourier parity (-1)^rho. The exact complementary complex aggregate retains |rho_U(v)|>T_rho, coprimality flips, affine births/deaths, carries, both endpoint arithmetic and literal changes, and square-root-phase changes under one outer real part. Its target remains open. Positive variation gives only Y kappa u X^epsilon against Qm kappa u X^epsilon, with deficit Y/(Qm). Bounded zero-extended height arrays have full normalized-Abel capacity; this is a mechanism control, not literal lower mass. This node proves only the strict sector and exact reduction, not the complete fast packet, complete t=1 residual, small-t owner, any parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent.

reject.reason: Endpoint-exact Abel summation returns the normalized jump packet exactly to the original height sum and supplies no saving by itself.
The determinant-fibre transport is exact on the integer fibre, but positivity, coprimality, squarefree, selector, profile, endpoint, and phase fields can change and create literal births and deaths.
The full pre-Fourier parity changes by (-1)^rho, while a retained mode has the carry-dependent factor (-1)^nu e(epsilon a rho/q).
On common unit heights the two orientations have the same carry parity, and their literal endpoints and phases are not an involutive pair.
Its proof is cardinality-only inverse-class sparsity; any prescribed set of the same number of unit inverse classes has the same positive bound.
The exact rho-large complement remains open after only the terminal and isolated Fejer projections are removed.
At T_rho=(U-1)/2 every unit inverse class is included, so the row complement is empty for that lift.
Because U divides u, each inverse class occurs O(u/U+1)=O(u/U) times on the O(u)-length literal support.
The exact m^(-1)c_q(a) lift cancels the m in the fixed Qm kappa u bound before positive outer summation.
They are exact joint complex linear projections over both orientations before a modulus; their complement is defined by complex subtraction.
Positive variation gives Y kappa u rather than Qm kappa u, with exact deficit Y/(Qm).
Coefficient-uniform positive or separable transforms retain the bounded-height-array capacity and do not prove the actual literal signed correlation.
The extremizing bounded height arrays need not arise from the fixed endpoint coefficients and supply no lower bound or disproof for the literal packet.
The exact rho-large fast remainder remains open before the accepted original-t=1 connectors can close.
Every complete M1 and M2 route, endpoint uniformity, M9, both bridges, and the quarter theorem remain incomplete.
